architecture: trusted external board binding and normalized feedback -> rf_safety_interlock
common H/V router ->8 independent TX calibration paths ->real FIR75/HB19 interpolation ->8 native DAC buses
final zero-code masking on current MUTE/stop/interlock deny

domains.controls: All non-AWG-control inputs synchronous clk_rf; normalized physical feedback requires board-specific CDC upstream. AWG preload uses existing acknowledged asynchronous loader.
domains.reset: Common rst_n; source CDC has per-domain release synchronizers. Top reset/fanout synchronization and physical shutdown remain integration responsibilities.

safety.binding: binding_valid must come from trusted validated board adapter, not software enable. UNBOUND yields rf_permit=0, PA enable request0, native DAC all-zero with valid0xff, and rejects nonzero mode/DDS/AWG start. Simulation test binding is not production binding.
safety.rf_permit: derived from actual rf_safety_interlock dac_mute/fault plus binding/timing/reset, not from tx_request alone
safety.parameter_rules: Unsigned clk_rf counts, validated and held stable while armed; nonzero timeout/watchdog. No physical levels, pins, RF codes or measured gains are embedded.
safety.heartbeat: External authoritative event; production must not tie high or auto-generate while host is stalled. Testbench heartbeat high is only a deterministic simulation fixture.
safety.stop: stop_request masks output immediately, suppresses RF tx_request, auto-selects MUTE, and stops internal sources. Caller may hold it through drain.
safety.mode_zero: A current mode0 request immediately masks output and cancels source work. It selects digital MUTE; RF arm/tx_request remain externally controlled.
safety.fault: Current hard fault or denied interlock output immediately masks DAC codes; PA request follows sequencer inhibition. Fault/permit loss auto-selects MUTE. Fault recovery requires clear_fault disarmed with healthy prerequisites, tx_request low to reach RX, then new TX preparation/mode/source commands. No waveform auto-resume.
safety.clock_loss: Logic clock disappearance still requires independent board fail-safe; not certified by this RTL

admission.configuration: config_commit goes to existing atomic TXchain commit policy: source-drained safe_boundary, mode0, FIR tail drained, no mode request. Configuration remains frozen otherwise. config_seen is latched only after real config_accepted.
admission.mode: Nonzero modes only forwarded when interlock permit, pipeline_ready, configuration, safe boundary and source drain all hold. Invalid mode or OTA LIVE still rejects through existing MUX. No nonzero mode request is queued before RF preparation.
admission.start_ready: After selected DDS/AWG mode is stable for two RF edges, path readiness and source drain must hold. AWG also requires synchronized completed active-table status. DDS/AWG commands outside this readiness or wrong mode reject explicitly.
admission.purpose: DDS cannot begin during TURNAROUND and lose its prefix before actual TX permission. DDS still applies its own future/aligned GSC legality checks.
admission.external_live_drfm: External streams enter same common chain and are valid-gated by path readiness. Upstream source owner must align stream start after accepted corresponding mode; LIVE single-antenna OTA remains forbidden.

awg.loading: Asynchronous acknowledged BEGIN/WRITE/COMMIT interface unchanged. In this full transmitter, actual table commit additionally requires mode0 and sources_drained safe boundary. Loading inactive memory is still possible while other work runs.
awg.ownership_stop: Stopped playback silently completes remaining local reads; canceled tail is never exposed after stop deassertion. sources_drained is only true once raw source state is empty.
awg.status_cdc: ctrl_active_valid response snapshot is synchronized back into clk_rf with2 ASYNC_REG stages for conservative AWG start readiness. Playback core also independently validates active table.
awg.limits: Default stop source drain may require remaining16384-table reads; no IP abort/DDR/MM2S added.

tx_data.native_layout: 8 paths x128bits, each4complex samples with I/Q signed16 native words; exact hardware RFDC mapping still external
tx_data.calibration: Per-DAC dc/gain/cal_valid/route values entirely input-supplied and latched by TXchain; no invented physical calibration constants.
tx_data.DDS_limits: H/V same phase and same peak32767; no independent polarization source gain/phase control here
tx_data.drain: pipeline_ready is existing TXchain guarded permit, including its58-clock FIR drain after stop/fault. sources_drained additionally covers canceled AWG reads/DDS pipeline. Together gate new mode/start, but physical RF guards remain interlock/board responsibility.

operator_sequence: Reset both domains and establish trusted timing/binding/feedback.
In mode0 at a safe drained boundary, commit TX routing/calibration; optionally preload and commit AWG.
Arm with tx_request low to enter RX, then assert tx_request and wait for RF TX permit and pipeline_ready.
Request intended mode at safe boundary; require mode_accepted.
Wait start_ready, then issue future DDS command or AWG play; require accepted pulse.
For stop/fault, outputs immediately zero and source/TX state drains; perform required RF recovery and submit new mode/waveform commands.

verification.icarus: PASS UNBOUND/early-start rejection,128 actual DDS calibrated samples on8 lanes, actual AWG eight DAC paths and steady-state H/V2:1 amplitudes, immediate faultzero-valid, reprepare no old tail, fresh8-sample DDS
verification.test_fixture: binding_valid/timing/feedback/unity gains and heartbeat are logical simulation stimuli, not physical validation

cdc.note: Includes the active-AWG-status synchronizer; held payload warnings remain physical timing-review requirements, not waivers.

verification.synthesis_warnings: 28 inherited generated FIR unused-zero/history/tree-element removal warnings; no synthesis errors/critical warnings. OOC clock-buffer location unknown, external IO unconstrained.

not_claimed: physical RF binding or RF emission measurement
